method.roster_definition: Frozen at added-hour start. Apply identical shop/SKU/exact food horizon roster to every window; do not count pre-feature missing flags as zero. Training purchases predate comparison windows; cohort roster is observational, not randomized.
method.baseline_selection_rule: Latest official Saved reference observation before actual cohort-policy buyer load; one hour before that time. Pick nearest official cached start observation and retain both neighboring points. Selection independent of subsequent observed performance.
limitations: Primary payment windows are exactly3600s; primary starting Saved is a cached official observation with a documented time offset, not an exact requested-boundary measurement.
Adjacent baseline includes code transition; report separately and never call it an entirely old-policy window.
Actual in-first-four positive model choices and payment are measured separately from fixed-roster payments.

Frozen roster is classified at the added-hour start, after the historical comparison windows. Its training purchases precede those windows, but some failure observations arrived later; this is retrospective descriptive attribution, not a causal backtest.

limits: Observed before 2026-11-17 23:59 KST. Final Class rank is not yet known.
Official cumulative board numbers and local captured log counts have different update times.
Week10 Saved predates retroactive patch3.6; do not interpret its difference as a policy gain.
